assertions.check: Contains user stories in 'As a [user], I want [action], so that [benefit]' format
Each user story has measurable acceptance criteria
MVP scope is explicitly defined with 'in scope' and 'out of scope' sections
Total MVP user stories number 15 or fewer
Contains a data model or entity list with relationships
Non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability) are stated
Success metrics are defined with specific numbers (not 'improve retention')
Each feature maps to a validated customer need from Phase 1
No feature exists that wasn't validated in customer discovery
Contains a prioritized backlog beyond MVP (what comes next)

meta_assertion: Could an engineering team build an MVP from this PRD without asking clarifying questions?
test_prompt: Write a PRD for the MVP of a developer deployment automation tool.
